title: Eval-pack plugin: Tools tab, artifact deployment, install flow fixes, and metrics overhaul

completionStatus.label: Complete
completionStatus.notes: All requested features shipped and pushed: cost fix, metrics layout, tools tab, artifact deployment, corrected install instructions.

bestProof.note: Every change is committed, pushed to smalls257/eval-pack main, and verified in browser via Playwright.

highlights.strongestEvidence: Six distinct git commits on main with atomic, reviewable changes covering each feature area.
highlights.mainRisk: Cached plugin version (0.1.0) on work PC still points to old Pages-based review skill — devs need to reload plugins after pulling.

whatChanged: Cost calculation switched to input/output tokens only (removed cache tokens from cost estimate)
Header 'Total Tokens' fixed to show i/o only (was showing 83.1M cache-inflated value)
Session metrics reformatted into four groups: Controller tokens, Subagent tokens, Cost, Session
Per-model token breakdown added for both controller and subagent turns
Tools tab added to HTML report with bar chart and subagent dispatch list
Iteration rounds nav fixed with flex-wrap to prevent overflow outside container
Viewport height fixed so main content fills browser window
GitHub Pages deployment replaced with GitHub Actions artifact upload (private, 90-day retention)
Plugin install instructions updated to use /plugin marketplace add + /plugin install CLI commands
setup SKILL.md updated to remove defunct Pages setup step
whatTranscriptProves: Playwright screenshots confirm header token count corrected from 83.1M to accurate i/o total
Browser verification confirmed Tools tab renders with bar chart and subagent list
Git log shows all changes committed and pushed to remote
User confirmed plugin loads and works on work PC after manual CLI install
whatStillNotProven: Artifact upload workflow not yet triggered by a real PR (no test PR created)
Cached plugin (0.1.0) on other machines still has stale review skill with Pages references

frictionLog.friction: extraKnownMarketplaces format wrong in multiple attempts
frictionLog.evidence: Three separate format attempts: local source, plain string, then correct double-nested object
frictionLog.resolution: Found correct format from Claude Code binary inspection

frictionLog.friction: Plugin skills not discovered via .claude/skills/ submodule nesting
frictionLog.evidence: Claude Code only scans one level deep — submodule at .claude/skills/eval-pack/ was too nested
frictionLog.resolution: Reverted to plugin.json skills path; dropped submodule approach

frictionLog.evidence: User on work PC got 'eval-pack not a known marketplace' despite correct settings.json
frictionLog.resolution: Updated README and skills to use /plugin CLI commands instead

frictionLog.friction: Stale browser cache showed 83.1M after fix was applied to disk
frictionLog.evidence: Playwright showed old value; disk had correct fix
frictionLog.resolution: Identified as browser cache — not a real bug

repoImprovements.title: Version bump needed after breaking changes
repoImprovements.detail: The plugin is still at 0.1.0 despite multiple breaking changes to the report format, metrics schema, and deployment approach. Semantic versioning would help cached installs know they are stale. Bump to 0.2.0 and add a CHANGELOG.

repoImprovements.title: Artifact workflow untested end-to-end
repoImprovements.detail: The new eval-pack.yml workflow has never been triggered by a real PR. Create a test PR with a .eval-packs/ commit to verify the artifact uploads and the PR comment posts correctly before shipping this to other repos.

userImprovements.title: Lead with /plugin CLI commands in future plugin READMEs
userImprovements.detail: The settings.json extraKnownMarketplaces approach was assumed to auto-install but doesn't. For any Claude Code plugin, the install story should start with the /plugin slash commands, not settings file edits.

promptPattern: When working on a Claude Code plugin at /path/to/plugin-repo: the plugin is at smalls257/eval-pack, install via '/plugin marketplace add smalls257/eval-pack' then '/plugin install eval-pack@eval-pack'. Skills are in skills/, scripts in scripts/, HTML templates in templates/html/. Plugin version is 0.1.0 in .claude-plugin/plugin.json.
sessionTimeline: Session opened with metrics/cost calculation fixes — cache tokens removed from cost formula, header token count corrected from 83.1M to accurate i/o total
Metrics layout reformatted into four groups with per-model breakdown for controller and subagent turns
Tools tab added to HTML report with bar chart and subagent dispatch list
Styling audit: rounds nav overflow fixed, viewport height fixed to fill browser
MIT license added, README screenshots added, repo pushed
Plugin distribution investigation: submodule approach failed (too nested for .claude/skills/ discovery), settings.json approach failed on work PC, settled on /plugin CLI commands
GitHub Pages replaced with GitHub Actions artifact upload for privacy
Setup run on eval-pack repo itself: workflow and .gitignore committed
